# Walks in Rome

> > Comprehensive walking tour guides to Rome's churches, monuments, and religious sites, established 2001

Walks in Rome provides detailed historical and architectural guides to Rome's religious heritage, including St Peter's Basilica, ancient churches, papal monuments, and themed walking tours. The site also features select guides to Florence and Venice landmarks.

## Key Topics

- Rome churches
- St Peter's Basilica
- Walking tours
- Religious architecture
- Papal monuments
- Catholic Church history
- Michelangelo
- Pope Urban VIII
- Pope Alexander VII
- Queen Christina of Sweden
- Countess Matilda of Canossa
- Vatican art
- Roman Forum
- Rioni districts
- Religious relics

## St Peter's Basilica

- [The Transept-St Peter's Basilica-Rome](https://www.walksinrome.com/the-transept-of-st-peters-basilica-in-rome.html): Detailed guide to St Peter's Basilica transept arms and chapels
- [The Funerary Monument to Pope Leo XI in St Peter's Basilica in Rome](https://www.walksinrome.com/monument-to-pope-leo-xi-st-peters-basilica.html): Alessandro Algardi's funerary monument to Pope Leo XI in St Peter's

## Major Churches of Rome

- [The Church of San Clemente in Rome](https://www.walksinrome.com/church-of-san-clemente-rome.html): San Clemente church guide showcasing Rome's multi-layered history
- [The Church of Santa Maria in Aracoeli in Rome](https://www.walksinrome.com/church-of-santa-maria-in-aracoeli.html): 13th century Santa Maria in Aracoeli church with legendary oracle origins
- [The Church of Santa Maria in Cosmedin in Rome](https://www.walksinrome.com/church-of-santa-maria-in-cosmedin-in-rome.html): Guide to Santa Maria in Cosmedin church founded by Pope Adrian I
- [The Church of Santi Cosma e Damiano in Rome](https://www.walksinrome.com/church-of-santi-cosma-e-damiano-rome.html): Hidden gem Santi Cosma e Damiano church next to the Roman Forum
- [The Church of San Silvestro in Capite in Rome](https://www.walksinrome.com/the-church-of-san-silvestro-in-capite.html): San Silvestro in Capite housing St John the Baptist head relic
- [The Church of St Paul Within the Walls in Rome](https://www.walksinrome.com/the-church-of-st-paul-within-the-walls-in-rome.html): First non-Catholic church built within Rome's walls
- [The Monumental Complex of Santo Spirito in Sassia in Rome](https://www.walksinrome.com/monumental-complex-of-santo-spirito-in-sassia-in-rome.html): Santo Spirito in Sassia complex dating to 727, pilgrims' hospice guide

## Walking Tours & Neighborhood Guides

- [A Literary Tour of Rome](https://www.walksinrome.com/a-literary-tour-of-rome.html): Walking tour following plaques marking foreign writers' residences in Rome
- [Churches and the Rioni of Rome](https://www.walksinrome.com/churches-and-the-rioni-of-rome.html): Guide to Rome's 14 rioni administrative districts and their churches

## Fountains & Ancient Sites

- [The Fountain of the Moor (Piazza Navona) in Rome](https://www.walksinrome.com/fountain-of-the-moor-piazza-navona.html): 1575 Fontana del Moro by Giacomo della Porta in Piazza Navona
- [The Temple of Mars Ultor in Rome](https://www.walksinrome.com/the-temple-of-mars-ultor-forum-of-augustus-rome.html): Ancient Temple of Mars Ultor ruins in Forum of Augustus

## Chapels & Artistic Highlights

- [The Cappella Chigi in the Church of Santa Maria della Pace in Rome](https://www.walksinrome.com/the-cappella-chigi-in-the-church-of-santa-maria-della-pace.html): Raphael-designed Cappella Chigi in Santa Maria della Pace church

## Beyond Rome: Florence & Venice

- [Florence: Piazza Santissima Annunziata: Fountains of the Marine Monsters](https://www.walksinrome.com/italy-florence-piazza-santissima-annunziata-fountains-of-the-marine-monsters.html): Bronze Marine Monsters fountains in Florence's Piazza Santissima Annunziata
- [The Winged Lions of St Mark in Venice](https://www.walksinrome.com/italy-venice-winged-lion-of-st-mark.html): Guide to Venice's winged lion symbol of patron saint St Mark

## Additional Churches

- [The Church of San Rocco all' Augusteo in Rome](https://www.walksinrome.com/the-church-of-san-rocco-in-rome.html): 1657 San Rocco church designed by Giovan Antonio de' Rossi
- [The Church of San Giuliano dei Fiamminghi in Rome](https://www.walksinrome.com/the-church-of-san-giuliano-dei-fiamminghi-in-rome.html): 18th century Flemish national church San Giuliano dei Fiamminghi
- [The Church of San Pasquale Baylon in Rome](https://www.walksinrome.com/the-church-of-san-pasquale-baylon-in-rome.html): San Pasquale Baylon church guide in Rome
- [The Church of Santa Maria dei Sette Dolori in Rome](https://www.walksinrome.com/the-church-of-santa-maria-dei-sette-dolori-in-rome.html): Santa Maria dei Sette Dolori church in Rome
